name: @nshiab/journalism-statistics
description: Useful TypeScript functions for journalism projects. This library focuses on statistical calculations.

scripts.docs: typedoc && node --input-type=module -e "import { readFileSync, writeFileSync, copyFileSync } from 'node:fs'; import config from './typedoc.json' with { type: 'json' }; writeFileSync('llms.txt', readFileSync('llms.txt', 'utf8').replaceAll('(llm.md#', '(' + new URL('llm.md', config.hostedBaseUrl).href + '#')); for (const file of ['llm.md', 'llms.txt']) copyFileSync(file, 'site/' + file);"
scripts.all-tests: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run docs
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run docs
scripts.version: npm run docs && git add llm.md llms.txt
